title: Cloth Fragment

title: Red Clay
content: The footprint contains red clay, which is found only near the rooftop garden.

title: Umbrella Dry Floor
content: The umbrella is wet, but the floor is dry, indicating it was brought inside after the rain started, possibly by someone who went out during the storm.

title: Midnight Meeting
content: The note says 'Meet me at midnight. Bring the key.' The key likely opens the display case.

title: Map Route
content: The map shows a route from the main hall to the roof. The red clay smudge matches the footprint clay.

title: Torn Glove
content: The torn glove suggests the thief might have injured their finger. The metal polish smell indicates handling of metal objects.

title: Crowbar Hair
content: A hair caught on the crowbar. It is black and short, possibly from the security guard.

title: Gem Fragment Match
content: The fragment matches the missing gem. It was found on the roof, suggesting the thief went there.
